scripts.lint:ci: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src/integrations/supabase/client.ts src/vite-env.d.ts src/test/setup.ts playwright.config.ts e2e/**/*.ts
scripts.cap:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:web:rider: npm run build:rider && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs rider
scripts.build:web:driver: npm run build:driver && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs driver
scripts.build:web:car: npm run build:car && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs car
scripts.build:web:admin: npm run build:admin && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs admin
scripts.build:web:all: npm run build:rider && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs rider && npm run build:driver && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs driver && npm run build:car && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs car && npm run build:admin && node scripts/copy-web-index.mjs admin
scripts.cap:sync:rider: npm run build:rider && copy dist-rider\rider.html dist-rider\index.html && copy capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && echo Rider synced
scripts.cap:sync:driver: npm run build:driver && copy dist-driver\driver.html dist-driver\index.html && copy capacitor.driver.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && copy capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && echo Driver synced
scripts.cap:sync:car: npm run build:car && copy dist-car\car.html dist-car\index.html && copy capacitor.car.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && copy capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && echo Car synced
scripts.apk:rider: npm run build:rider && copy /y dist-rider\\rider.html dist-rider\\index.html && copy /y capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRiderDebug && cd .. && if not exist builds mkdir builds && del /f /q builds\\rider.apk 2>nul & copy /y android\\app\\build\\outputs\\apk\\rider\\debug\\app-rider-debug.apk builds\\rider.apk && copy /y capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts
scripts.apk:driver: npm run build:driver && copy dist-driver\driver.html dist-driver\index.html && copy capacitor.driver.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleCaptainDebug && cd .. && if not exist builds mkdir builds && copy android\app\build\outputs\apk\captain\debug\app-captain-debug.apk builds\driver.apk && copy capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts
scripts.apk:car: npm run build:car && copy dist-car\car.html dist-car\index.html && copy capacitor.car.config.ts capacitor.config.ts && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleCarDebug && cd .. && if not exist builds mkdir builds && copy android\app\build\outputs\apk\car\debug\app-car-debug.apk builds\car.apk && copy capacitor.rider.config.ts capacitor.config.ts
scripts.apk:all: npm run apk:rider && npm run apk:driver && npm run apk:car
scripts.check:migrations: echo '🔍 فحص ملفات migrations...' && git diff --name-only HEAD | grep 'supabase/migrations' || echo '✅ لا توجد تعديلات'
scripts.check:deletes: echo '🔍 فحص عمليات الحذف...' && grep -r '\.delete()' src/ || echo '✅ لا توجد عمليات حذف جديدة'
scripts.check:all: npm run check:migrations && npm run check:deletes
scripts.safety-check: echo '⚠️ تذكير: اقرأ .github/copilot-instructions.md قبل أي push!'
